_comment: Faults injected into the LIVE demo window (index = 5-minute sample within the live stream, 0..95). Each has a known ground-truth root cause so PRISM's diagnosis can be scored. All FICTITIOUS.

scenarios.description: Upstream transformer T1 develops a voltage sag; every downstream asset reads low voltage - the classic 'one cause, many symptoms' event.
PDU P2 is driven past rated capacity by a load spike. A local fault with no upstream propagation.
UPS B1 battery string degrades; state-of-charge reserve falls. Needs a physical battery replacement, so PRISM must escalate.
UPS A1 power-module temperature climbs toward a trip point. Auto-remediable via cooling and load throttling.
Non-linear load pushes harmonic distortion on PDU P1 above the limit. Auto-remediable via the active harmonic filter.
Breaker B4 trips on a transient, cutting power to Server Rack R4. PRISM runs a downstream fault check and performs a remote reclose.
